name: Jadunath Sarkar
contribution: Jadunath Sarkar produced influential scholarly histories of Mughal India, especially the reigns and institutions of Aurangzeb and the later Mughal state.
context: Modern historical scholarship in colonial Bengal and the development of archival research on Mughal India.
impact: His works shaped twentieth-century historical writing in South Asia, while later scholars have debated his interpretations and source selection.
highlight: Jadunath Sarkar was one of the most influential historians of Mughal India from colonial Bengal.
seoTitle: Jadunath Sarkar: Historian of Mughal India
seoDescription: Learn about Jadunath Sarkar's histories of Mughal India, archival method, and influence on South Asian historiography.
shortAnswer: Jadunath Sarkar was a Bengali historian known for major studies of Mughal India and Aurangzeb's reign.
